prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: hero image for a 10-minute scavenger hunt Bible lesson for two young children, Luke and Sally. Create a warm, inviting watercolor and gouache storybook illustration in landscape 3:2 format. Scene: an ancient Judean watchman stands calmly on a small limestone watchtower in a sunlit landscape with an olive tree and a winding path. He shades his eyes with one hand, looking into the distance. In the foreground, two fictional young children in modern modest everyday clothes, a preschool-age boy with short light brown hair and an early-elementary-age girl with light brown hair, look curiously upward toward the tower. The boy holds a small flashlight; the girl holds a simple hand mirror. Their objects are ordinary household things, not magical. Gentle natural expressions, charming illustrated faces, sage green, golden ochre, cream, dusty blue; soft paper texture. This is an imagined teaching scene, not an exact historical event; the children's contemporary clothes clearly distinguish them. Peaceful and child-friendly, no soldiers, weapons, danger, cliffs, dark imagery, logos, words, watermarks, or text. Leave breathing room around the scene; full-bleed single scene, polished and detailed.
